title.zh: Git 如何存下全部历史

desc.zh: 每次敲下 git add 和 git commit，Git 并没有在 .git/ 里存一叠补丁，而是把整棵目录树写成了不可变的内容寻址对象。这篇按 Git 2.56.0 的真实字节格式与源码文档，从一条 git commit 往下追：.git 目录地图，blob 头与 SHA-1/SHA-256，tree 的二进制排布与子树共享，commit 有向无环图，index 的 stat 缓存与 Racy Git，分支、HEAD 与 reflog 的垃圾回收边界，Myers diff 与三方合并，packfile 的 COPY/INSERT 增量字节码与扇出索引，协议 v2 与部分克隆，以及 reftable、SHA-256 过渡和稀疏索引。九个可动手模型都在页面里重写算法，并与本机真实的 git 2.56.0 逐项对过数。
desc.en: Every time you run git add and git commit, Git does not store a stack of patches inside .git/—it writes an entire directory snapshot as immutable, content-addressed objects. Following Git 2.56.0 byte formats and primary documentation, this essay traces one commit all the way down: the .git/ map, blob headers and SHA-1/SHA-256, binary tree sorting and subtree sharing, the commit DAG, the index stat cache and Racy Git, refs, HEAD and reflog reachability, Myers diff and 3-way merge, packfile COPY/INSERT delta opcodes and fanout indices, wire protocol v2 and partial clones, and the reftable/SHA-256/sparse-index frontier. Nine hands-on models run the real algorithms rewritten in the page and crosschecked item by item against git 2.56.0.

title.zh: .git 目录的四个区与 Git 工作流程
title.en: The four regions of a Git repository

desc.zh: Git 把仓库分成工作区、暂存区（.git/index）、不可变对象库（.git/objects/）与可变引用（HEAD 与 refs/）；git add 写对象并记入索引，git commit 只向前推动分支指针。
desc.en: Git separates the working tree, staging index (.git/index), immutable object store (.git/objects/), and mutable pointers (HEAD and refs/); git add writes blobs and index entries while git commit advances the branch pointer.

zh: git add 和 git commit 做了什么

title.zh: Git Blob 对象与内容寻址哈希
title.en: Git blob objects and content addressing

desc.zh: Git 在文件内容前拼上 blob <size>\0，经 SHA-1 或 SHA-256 算出对象 ID，再经 zlib 压缩写入 .git/objects/ 前两位十六进制分片目录。
desc.en: Git prepends blob <size>\0 to file bytes, hashes the buffer with SHA-1 or SHA-256 to obtain its object ID, and stores the zlib-compressed result under a two-hex-char shard directory.

zh: git 为什么按哈希存文件

title.zh: Git Tree 快照与 Merkle 子树共享
title.en: Git tree snapshots and Merkle subtree sharing

desc.zh: tree 对象按排序的二进制条目指代文件名、权限模式与子对象哈希；只改一个文件时，未改动的目录和文件按哈希指针原封不动复用，无需全量拷贝。
desc.en: A tree object encodes sorted binary entries mapping modes and filenames to raw 20- or 32-byte object hashes; editing one file mints new trees only along its ancestor path while reusing all unchanged subtrees.

zh: 为什么 git 每次存全量快照却不占空间
en: why git snapshots do not blow up disk space

title.zh: Commit 对象与不可变提交有向无环图
title.en: Commit objects and the immutable DAG

desc.zh: commit 记录根 tree 与 parent 哈希形成不可变 DAG；amend 与 rebase 从不原地改写旧提交，而是生成全新哈希的节点再移动分支引用。
desc.en: Commits link root trees and parent hashes into an immutable DAG; amend and rebase never mutate existing commits—they mint newly hashed commits and move branch references.

zh: git rebase 为什么会改变哈希
git amend 改写历史原理
en: why git rebase changes commit hashes

title.zh: Git 暂存区 stat 缓存与 Racy Git
title.en: Git index stat cache and Racy Git

desc.zh: .git/index 把暂存清单与 lstat 元数据缓存存在一起，让 git status 跳过干净文件的磁盘读取；面对同秒原地改写的 Racy Git 竞态则会把缓存大小截零强制重算。
desc.en: .git/index pairs staged object IDs with lstat metadata so git status skips reading unchanged files; for same-tick edits (Racy Git), Git zeroes cached size to force content re-hashing.

zh: git status 为什么这么快
en: why is git status so fast

title.zh: 分支、HEAD、标签与 reflog 垃圾回收
title.en: Branches, HEAD, tags and reflog GC

desc.zh: 分支只是 41 字节文件，HEAD 通常是指向分支的符号引用；git reset --hard 移走指针后，本地 logs/HEAD 仍保住旧提交默认 30 天直至 reflog 过期并运行 git gc。
desc.en: A branch is a 41-byte file and HEAD is a symbolic ref; after git reset --hard, local .git/logs/HEAD keeps dropped commits alive for 30 days by default until reflog expiry and git gc.

en: what is a git branch internally

title.zh: Myers 差分与三方合并冲突

desc.zh: git diff 按 Eugene Myers 最短编辑脚本现算行差异；git merge 先在提交图找共同祖先 B，对比 B→Ours 与 B→Theirs，在重叠修改处产出冲突标记。
desc.en: git diff computes Eugene Myers's shortest edit script lazily from snapshots; git merge finds the merge base B on the commit DAG, diffs B→Ours and B→Theirs, and marks overlapping changes.

zh: git 合并冲突怎么来的

title.zh: Packfile 增量压缩与 .idx 扇出索引

desc.zh: 打包时 Git 按类型、路径与体积降序排列对象，在滑动窗口里将旧版编码为回指新版的 COPY/INSERT 增量流，并以 256 桶扇出表 .idx 快速定位。
desc.en: During packing, Git sorts objects by type, path hash, and descending size, encodes older revisions as COPY/INSERT deltas against newer bases via a sliding window, and indexes them with a 256-bucket fanout .idx.

title.zh: 协议 v2、浅克隆与部分克隆
title.en: Wire protocol v2, shallow & partial clones

desc.zh: git fetch 通过协议 v2 的 ls-refs 与 have/want 协商传输缺失瘦包；--depth 截断历史，而 --filter=blob:none 保留全图拓扑并按需从 promisor 远端拉取大文件。
desc.en: git fetch uses wire protocol v2 ls-refs and have/want negotiation to stream thin packs; --depth truncates history while --filter=blob:none preserves full graph topology and fetches blobs lazily from promisor remotes.

en: how git clone works over the network

title.zh: Reftable 引用后端、SHA-256 与稀疏索引前沿
title.en: Reftable backend, SHA-256 transition & sparse index

desc.zh: 截至 Git 2.56.0（2026 年 11 月），prefix 压缩的 reftable 引用后端已成熟并列入 Git 3.0 默认清单，scalar 与锥形稀疏索引支撑超大仓，而 SHA-1/SHA-256 互通仍处于实验阶段。
desc.en: As of Git 2.56.0 (November 2026), the prefix-compressed reftable backend is mature and slated for Git 3.0 defaults alongside scalar sparse indexing, while SHA-1/SHA-256 repo interoperability remains incomplete.
